download_ed_single_task_model: download the pretrained polyencoder retrieval model for the EmpatheticDialogues task to a given datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the ed_single_task v1.0 model archive into the blended_skill_talk folder
review_download_function: review the download function that uses parlai core build_data to fetch the EmpatheticDialogues model
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that configures and retrieves the ed_single_task pretrained model
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the model archive is retrieved
